description: NaCaCeBiO₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnnn space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.40 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.43 Å. There are two inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Ca-O bond lengths are 2.36 Å. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded to twelve O atoms to form CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share faces with four equivalent CeO₆ octahedra and faces with four equivalent BiO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.87-2.97 Å. Ce is bonded to six O atoms to form CeO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BiO₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-34°. There are four shorter (2.23 Å) and two longer (2.25 Å) Ce-O bond lengths. Bi is bonded to six O atoms to form BiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CeO₆ octahedra and faces with two equivalent CaO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 30-34°. There are two shorter (2.13 Å) and four longer (2.14 Å) Bi-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Ce, and one Bi atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Ce, and one Bi atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Ca, one Ce, and one Bi atom.
